title: "Informing the DAG"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-04-08"

```{r  , echo=FALSE,message = FALSE}
remove(list=ls())
scriptPath <- rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
scriptDir <- dirname(scriptPath)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
coding=read_csv(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data','read_only' ,'coding_report.csv'))
names(coding)[5]='id_sub'
evts=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
    sheet = "events")
names(evts)[2]='desc'
f.style=coding[coding$id_q==0,c('id_I','value')]
names(f.style)[2]='style'
quest=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
    sheet = "questions")
resp=readxl::read_excel(file.path(scriptDir, '..', 'data', 'values.xlsx'), 
                        sheet = "responses")
#resp$id_I=as.character(resp$id_I)
coding=coding[coding$id_q %in% c(11,12,36:43),]

df=coding%>%
  left_join(resp, by=c('id_I', 'id_q'))%>%
  left_join(f.style)%>%
  #left_join(evts.style, by=c('id_sub','id_I'))%>%
  left_join(quest)
```




```{r, include=T, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 1,results = 'asis', fig.pos='H', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#knitr::include_graphics(file.path(main.dir,x.folder,j.images), dpi = 300)
#for(i in 1:1){
write.csv(df,file.path('C:/github/extreme_weather_risk', 'data/costs.csv'), row.names = F)
ppl=unique(df$id_I)

for(i in 1:length(ppl)){
  
  i.df=df[df$id_I == ppl[i],c( "id_I" ,  "style" ,"id_q" , "short_description","value"  ,"range.lwr" ,  "range.upr"  ,"unit_range" ,  "text" )]
  kable.obj=kableExtra::kable((i.df), booktabs = TRUE) %>%
            kable_styling(font_size = 8)%>% 
            row_spec(0,   bold = TRUE)%>%
            row_spec(1:(nrow(i.df)-1),hline_after=T)%>%
            column_spec(c(1,3,5:7), width = "0.5cm")%>%
            column_spec(c(2,8), width = "1cm")%>%
            column_spec(4, width = "2cm")%>%
            column_spec(9, width = "6cm")
    print(kable.obj)
    
    cat('\\newpage\n\n')
      
}
```
